name: TakBull Invoice For WooCommerce
author: supporttakbull

sections.description:
Invoicing for all payments you get from woocommerce payment gateways !

Boost conversion by offering product and cart page checkout

Connect smoothly and email invoicing at the end of each transaction
advanced features : automated invoicing,

Support

For more information or questions, please email support@takbull.co.il.

External Services

This plugin relies on the TakBull API, a third-party external service, to automatically generate invoices for WooCommerce orders.

What is TakBull and what is it used for?

TakBull is an invoicing service provided by TakBull (https://takbull.co.il). This plugin connects to the TakBull API (https://api.takbull.co.il/) to automatically create invoices, receipts, tax invoices, and donation receipts when WooCommerce orders are completed or processed.

What data is sent and when?

When a WooCommerce order is completed or processed, the following data is automatically sent to the TakBull API:

  • Customer Information: Customer name, email address, phone number, billing address (address line 1 & 2, city, country, postal code)
  • Order Information: Order ID, order total, currency, payment method, transaction/reference ID, order date
  • Product Details: Product SKU, product name/description, price, quantity, tax amount, discount amount, tax status
  • Shipping Information: Shipping cost, shipping tax, shipping postal code
  • Additional Settings: Document type, language locale, invoice delivery preferences (email/SMS)

This data transmission occurs automatically when:
– A WooCommerce order status changes to “completed” or “processing”
– The order total is greater than zero
– The order does not already have a TakBull invoice generated

Service Provider Information

Service Provider: TakBull
Service Website: https://takbull.co.il
API Endpoint: https://api.takbull.co.il/
Terms of Service: https://takbull.co.il/terms

Note: You must obtain API credentials from TakBull to use this plugin. By using this plugin, you agree to transmit customer and order data to TakBull’s servers for invoice generation purposes.
